0.original: Just like you, Donuhanu is awaiting Pashenine's return.

1.original: Donuhanu has asked that you procure Yok Huy plecos for Pashenine's rite of passage.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Yok Huy plecos can be fished from waters Hanu using honeybees as bait.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 165. Delivering items with a rating of 388 or more will earn greater rewards.

2.original: You deliver the Yok Huy plecos to Donuhanu. As new interest in unusual catches begins to take root, continue to provide support to Fish Fancies Donuhanu.

24.original: Catch Yok Huy plecos in waters Hanu and deliver them to Donuhanu.

48.original: Pashenine should be back at any moment, I'd wager. ...At least, I hope so!

49.original: Apologies for the wait. I believe I've mastered my command over the king puffer phantasms.

50.original: Their spines were able to pierce a wooden mannequin with ease─they should go right through a giant toad!

51.original: My rite of passage will demand much of me, however. I will need an arsenal of fish before attempting it.

52.original: Among my marks will be a gargantuan tortoise with a shell as hard as stone.

53.original: Tell me, Donuhanu─do you know of a fish sturdy enough to combat such a foe?

54.original: There's no fish sturdier than the Yok Huy pleco. Their scales are as good as armor─if armor were as good as their scales!

55.original: You can find them in waters Hanu, and they can't resist a honeybee on a hook.

56.original: Off you go now, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! To Kozama'uka with you!

57.original: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I appreciate your help.

58.original: The Yok Huy plecos we need should be swimmin' in waters Hanu. Cast in some honeybees, and soon <hex:021A020203>you'll<hex:021A020103> be swimmin' in Yok Huy plecos!

59.original: A fish sturdy enough to shatter rock will doubtless be useful outside the hunt as well.

60.original: Breaking stone, molding clay─there are countless ways I might support my community with it!

61.original: Ah, brings back memories! Many a happy day I spent splashin' about in waters Hanu and watchin' the Yok Huy plecos wiggle by...

62.original: Firm! Very firm, indeed! If I didn't know better, I'd say you just handed me solid ore!

63.original: What do you think, Pashenine? <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> outdid <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>self, if you ask me!

64.original: “By neither beak nor talon,” as we say in Ok'hanu─nothin' cracks a Yok Huy pleco without its say-so!

65.original: Perfect! I daresay I shall need a chisel...

66.original: Just look at all this plump meat! Enough for me to get the energies I need, and then much more.

67.original: Would you both care for a bite? The soft parts, here...

68.original: As rich as any terrestrial game, wouldn't you say? What's more, the shell serves as a natural seal during frying, trapping its subtle flavors inside.

69.original: You really know your cookin', Pashenine! I've never ventured far beyond a hot grill and sprinkle of salt myself─but havin' tasted your pleco all but proves that for every fancy fish there's an equally fancy recipe!

71.original: Your fish wouldn't happen to be for sale, would it? I came to market on another errand, but that aroma is simply to die for!

72.original: Er...my apologies, ma'am, but that fish is already spoken for...

73.original: Nonsense. I have partaken all that I require, so you are welcome to the rest. As for the recipe, it's really quite simple─first, you shall need a small chisel...

74.original: It's workin', <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! The people are perusin' our pretties!

75.original: I never gave much thought to recipes─but now I see they can sell a fish all on their own. And the more fish Pashenine masters, the more recipes we'll have to win new customers!

76.original: Let's both keep our skills sharp, eh, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>? There's no tellin' what Pashenine will need next!

77.original: Donuhanu is delighted with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Firm Fish Finder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

78.original: The next quest will be available from Donuhanu upon reaching level 95 as a fisher.

79.original: In order to undertake the subsequent quest, you must first complete the main scenario quest “The Skyruin.”
